rules.statement: Seeds must be logged for every random run, and every failing seed shall be reproducible.

rules.condition: after reset of both domains is released
rules.statement: After reset release, empty = 1, full = 0, flags are clear and pointers are 0.

rules.condition: writing N words then reading N words
rules.statement: o_rd_data must equal the head word before every read; data returns the same, in the same order, show-ahead.

rules.condition: writing while the FIFO is full
rules.statement: When full = 1 and writing continues, overflow is raised and no data or pointer changes.

rules.condition: reading while the FIFO is empty
rules.statement: When empty = 1 and reading continues, underflow is raised and the pointer is unchanged.

rules.condition: filling and draining across the threshold
rules.statement: Threshold flags must behave per REQ-FUNC-010 for several i_full_thr and i_empty_thr values.

rules.condition: random clock ratios with phase drift
rules.statement: With random clock ratios (write faster, read faster, equal, drift) there must be no data error and no flag error.
Flag latency must equal S destination clock edges.
Each bit output changes at edge S, S+1 or S+2; there is no data error and flags are never optimistic.

rules.condition: CFG-CELL, options 1 to 4 in both VLSIT_SYNTHESIS branches and both reset flavours
rules.statement: FIFO behaves as the RTL branch; wrapper alone for options 0 to 4 has latency 0, 2, 2, 3, 4 and the listed reset value.

rules.condition: macro configuration with VLSIT_CELL_SRAM_1W1R in both branches
rules.statement: Behavior must be the same as the RTL array.
The testbench configuration list must use only legal values.
Gray pointers change only one bit per cycle.

rules.condition: simultaneous write and read, and pointer wrap-around
rules.statement: Same-cycle write and read, and pointer wrap-around, must cause no error.

rules.condition: reset in mid operation of both domains together
rules.statement: The FIFO must restart cleanly.
Top instantiates only wr, rd and mem; mem is not inside wr or rd.
Design follows REF-003 lint rules with no latch, no combinational loop and no tab.
Only approved crossings exist, with no logic before or between synchronizer stages.
Constraints are applied and exceptions are consistent.

rules.condition: building m_vlsit_afifo_sync, m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync, m_vlsit_afifo_ram_macro with and without VLSIT_SYNTHESIS
rules.statement: With the macro the synthesizable branch runs and passes the full regression; without it the model runs.

rules.condition: software reset with FIFO empty, partial and full
rules.statement: Handshake order is respected; after release pointers are 0, empty = 1, full = 0, and read is released before write.

rules.condition: software reset under random traffic, i_rst_n_sw width 1 to 12 cycles
rules.statement: No access is accepted while blocked, no data error and no deadlock occur.

rules.condition: software reset with metastability model and several seeds
rules.statement: The sequence completes and the flush check is never violated.
Behavior in TEST-002 to TEST-004 must be the same as after a hardware reset.

rules.condition: i_rst_n_sw re-asserted in REL, or hardware reset of one or both domains during sequence
rules.statement: Behavior must follow DEC-031 and DEC-032.

rules.condition: CDC analysis of CDC-005 and CDC-006
rules.statement: Crossings are 1-bit synchronized levels with no logic before the first stage.
Assertions are disabled during reset.
Full and empty are never both 1.
A Gray pointer register changes at most one bit per cycle.
The write pointer and storage remain unchanged.

rules.condition: read accepted by the read side
rules.statement: The read returns the word written to that entry, with no scoreboard mismatch.
Full flag is never 0 when physically full; empty flag is never 0 when physically empty.
The read pointer remains unchanged.
No write is accepted while wr_blk = 1.
No read is accepted while rd_blk = 1.
ack_rd rises only when the read pointer is 0 and the read FSM is not in RUN.
req_wr falls only after the acknowledge was seen and i_rst_n_sw = 1; ack_rd falls only after the synchronized request is 0.
The read pointer and synchronized write pointer are 0.
The write pointer and synchronized read pointer are 0.
The read FSM returns to RUN before the write FSM.
Both FSMs return to RUN within a bounded number of cycles.
o_sw_rst_busy equals (write FSM not in RUN) and is 0 after hardware reset.
Write block equals o_sw_rst_busy OR (i_rst_n_sw = 0); o_sw_rst_busy rises only at RUN to REQ and falls only at REL to RUN.

rules.condition: until the entry has been written
rules.statement: Resetless storage is not checked for X until its entry has been written.
A read is accepted only when empty = 0.
Formal proves one-bit change of Gray pointers, flags never optimistic, overflow/underflow leave state unchanged, no entry overwritten before read, and SVA-007 to SVA-016.
